FIELD.NAME: contact
FIELD.COMMENT: Contact email for the registering site

FIELD.NAME: serviceuserid
FIELD.COMMENT: Dedicated Moodle user account (auth=manual, suspended until approval) that the site's WS token is minted against; the token itself (the 'site key') is never stored, only mintable/revocable via this account

FIELD.NAME: summaryformat
FIELD.COMMENT: FORMAT_* of summary. Defaults to FORMAT_HTML(1) because every output site already rendered the summary as HTML before this column existed, so that is what the stored data is

FIELD.NAME: tags
FIELD.COMMENT: comma-separated subject tags

FIELD.NAME: activitytype
FIELD.COMMENT: modname, set when type=activity

FIELD.NAME: dataresourcetype
FIELD.COMMENT: glossary|questionbank|other, set when type=data

FIELD.NAME: creatorid
FIELD.COMMENT: Exchange-local userid of the creator

FIELD.NAME: siteid
FIELD.COMMENT: null for a direct upload with no client site involved

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: published|pending|hidden|removed|modhidden|deleted — 'hidden' is the author's own switch, 'modhidden'/'removed' are moderator takedowns only a moderator can lift

FIELD.NAME: trydisabled
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = the author has declined sandbox (Try it) availability

FIELD.NAME: trydisabledreason
FIELD.COMMENT: optional author-supplied reason shown in place of the Try it button

FIELD.NAME: timeshared
FIELD.COMMENT: when the resource was first published; never changes on update

FIELD.NAME: timefresh
FIELD.COMMENT: last moment the resource was known fresh: set on publish, on every new version, and by the author's Still fresh confirmation — the abandoned-courseware clock

FIELD.NAME: stalenotifiedtime
FIELD.COMMENT: when the stale warning was sent to the author; 0 = not currently flagged. Every writer of timefresh resets this to 0

FIELD.NAME: modhiddentime
FIELD.COMMENT: when a moderator took this resource down; 0 = not currently held. Reset to 0 on restore

FIELD.NAME: modhiddenby
FIELD.COMMENT: the moderator who took it down; 0 once that user has been through GDPR erasure, and 0 for the stale-courseware janitor's automatic removals, which is what distinguishes them from a real takedown

FIELD.NAME: modhiddenversionid
FIELD.COMMENT: the current ready version at the moment of the takedown, so the moderator report can tell whether the content has changed since. timemodified cannot answer that: it does not move for a cover-image or co-author change, and it does move for hide/unhide itself

TABLE.NAME: local_oerexchange_coauthors
TABLE.COMMENT: Additional authors of a resource. A row grants its user exactly the same rights over the resource as its creator; the creator themself is never a row here (they are resources.creatorid)

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Exchange-local userid of the co-author

FIELD.NAME: addedby
FIELD.COMMENT: Exchange-local userid who added them; 0 once that user has been through GDPR erasure

TABLE.NAME: local_oerexchange_versions
TABLE.COMMENT: Uploaded backup files for a resource. Only ONE row is ever status=ready — updating supersedes the previous one and deletes its file, keeping the row so imports/trials references never dangle

FIELD.NAME: itemid
FIELD.COMMENT: File API itemid, component local_oerexchange, filearea resource

FIELD.NAME: requiredplugins
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON array of {type,name} non-core components found in the backup

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: parsing|ready|failed|superseded — only one version per resource is ever ready; see resource_manager::supersede_old_versions()

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Exchange-local userid, null if unlinked importer

TABLE.NAME: local_oerexchange_trials
TABLE.COMMENT: Sandbox trial launches (analytics/audit only, option-B design)

TABLE.NAME: local_oerexchange_linkcodes
TABLE.COMMENT: Short-lived signed single-use codes for the account-linking handshake

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Exchange-local userid the token belongs to

FIELD.NAME: token
FIELD.COMMENT: core web service token, consumed once then cleared

TABLE.NAME: local_oerexchange_pluginallowlist
TABLE.COMMENT: Exchange-curated contrib plugins installable in sandbox trials

FIELD.NAME: moodlebranch
FIELD.COMMENT: e.g. MOODLE_502_STABLE

FIELD.NAME: sourceurl
FIELD.COMMENT: Upstream release ZIP this entry was mirrored from

FIELD.NAME: itemid
FIELD.COMMENT: File API itemid of the same-origin mirrored ZIP

FIELD.NAME: bake
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = baked into the bundle at build time rather than installed at trial boot

FIELD.NAME: component
FIELD.COMMENT: Frankenstyle name, derived from the ZIP's version.php - plugintype/pluginname split out for the existing consumers. No DEFAULT: XMLDB rejects '' on a NOT NULL char and emits a debugging message, which fails moodle-plugin-ci's install

FIELD.NAME: parentid
FIELD.COMMENT: The entry that pulled this one in as a dependency; null when an admin added it directly

FIELD.NAME: pluginversion
FIELD.COMMENT: The mirrored ZIP's own $plugin->version

FIELD.NAME: pluginrelease
FIELD.COMMENT: The mirrored ZIP's own $plugin->release, for display

INDEX.NAME: typenamebranch
INDEX.COMMENT: Unique: re-adding a plugin updates its entry in place rather than duplicating it

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Exchange-local userid this profile belongs to

FIELD.NAME: slug
FIELD.COMMENT: Drives the /u/{slug} URL

FIELD.NAME: expertise
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON array of free-text expertise tags

FIELD.NAME: visible
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 = owner has hidden this profile

FIELD.NAME: badgekey
FIELD.COMMENT: e.g. trusted_contributor

TABLE.NAME: local_oerexchange_modnotes
TABLE.COMMENT: A moderator's working note about one resource's status, readable and editable by every moderator. Kept off the resources row deliberately: the note carries a moderator's userid and prose, which is personal data, and the resources row is scrubbed and tombstoned by a different code path

FIELD.NAME: usermodified
FIELD.COMMENT: the moderator who last saved the note; 0 once that user has been through GDPR erasure
